content.label: Need to be able to set timed reminders if consents and previsit docs are not done automatically.  I am so frustrated by the payment system, checking people out and applying wallet so ridiculous honestly. Not easy at all.  The doc system is fine- sometimes it doesnt save consents or glitches and loses pictures but its not a tragedy.  Its just so expensive to be so hard to sell a skincare peoduct out of one screen, into another screen back into another.  Why not just allow us to do it right from check out.  You need to be able to have buttons add additional service- add retail sale.   Exhausting

This is my second review. Couple of issues from my previous review like texting on the app had been addressed.
However with new updates, they had really messed up the charting of medical supplies. Before once your category is medical supplies you could add units to your charting in one click and be done. Now it’s a 3 step to add medical supply and a make up of some other steps that didn’t even make sense. 
2: From my previous recommendation Date of birth now has been added but please can we have a way of identifying patients as new or established pls?
3: It would be great to have a PICTURE option for Health visit encounters, especially for weight mx where it matters
4: There is wrong pairing of Coolsculpting with body contouring option as if the only option for body contouring is coolsculpting, you would have to manually edit your procedure on a webpage ( not even on your app) to remove or change the cool sculpting if you don’t offer this. I have reported all these to support and added this to new developments suggestion but no response yet!!

I’ve been using AR for four years. It’s gone from straight up terrible to somewhat manageable but only because they introduced LeadAR for managing patient calls and tracking leads. AR is so lacking in features it’s barely passable as an EMR. 

The biggest issues are the patient documenting, bloated and disjointed layout, slow interface, and the patient portal. Patients cannot easily login to the portal. If they miss their initial welcome email when they make their first appointment (which is highly likely) the system will never let them in unless an admin resends this invite email and the patient opens it, clicks the links to verify their phone and email, and confirms their personal details. There’s no self-service button for the patients to do this on their own. It’s the dumbest thing. What software doesn’t allow users to reset their own login? 

Their customer service is absolute garbage. Nobody can answer a damn question and they will treat you like you’re the idiot, even though they don’t bother testing their own shoddy product or attempting to understand where any of the common problems are. They’re more preoccupied with their cute conferences and podcasts. .

title.label: You get what you pay for

content.label: It is very inexpensive! Customer service is frustrating and slow. The updates are frequent and can slow down progress with charting to a turtles pace. When you speak with customer service, they blame it on your device, your cache anything but their app. It can take way too long to actually get support while you have a patient in your office and you’re getting increasingly frustrated and need immediate assistance. If it weren’t so difficult to port over to a new EMR, I would’ve done it years ago.

There’s so many updates and it only seems to slow the practice down. The new consents are redundant and makes no sense. We need to be able to put credit card fees to clients and we’ve ask multiple times for this feature. There needs to be more options for before and after pictures. After the latest update the ability to pull up pictures while in the visit note isn’t an option. This is not well thought out or user friendly.
Super slow now

When we are in the workplace, we cannot look for our phones for a code to get into our records. In fact, most workspaces would like for us to not be on our phones. They are locked and put away during work hours. To check people in and check people out or even take payment. Having the second authentication makes Aesthetic Record very difficult to use in the workspace it is a very slow and hard process just to get Aesthetic Record to work properly or even sign in. 
Has not been our favorite!

App. isn’t great. It needs updates to the UI, search experience, navigation, different views, and reporting. 

App. is all around not great. There are features that haven’t been invested in that should be. It also is constantly crashing.
They made two-factor authentication mandatory, and it made the program very inconvenient and difficult to use because of all the extra codes.

When building out the schedule for the month, the only view is the individual provider schedule. There is no way to see when all providers are scheduled to work in the calendar month. 

It would be beneficial to have a full view of who is in the schedule and sort out providers by Color to see who’s working what days. This would be for the provider scheduling view only. Most providers don’t have a basic 9-5 and many have alternating schedules that can’t be duplicated so this would make it easier to see the schedule ahead and to know where there is a need for a provider to work

Need to update online booking. Patient has trouble clicking service on online booking they then have to click service again at the bottom to allow processing to next screen. Many calls where patients are getting stuck. Asked company to fix it several times. It’s an easy update.

The app kicks me out every time from one. It’s very annoying. Also the constant updates are obnoxious too because they don’t seem to make anything easier.
Terrible

title.label: Excessive Middle of the day updates hurts my business

content.label: There is not one company in there right minds who would schedule an update in the middle of the work day, except for Aesthetic RECORDS! This is a true account: I start charting on a client putting in information all to get ready to save/move on and it updates at that point causing a loss in charted information. Not only does it up dates you must click the update button on the actual app as if you are downloading the app for the first time. Updates should be done in the background/at night/never in the middle of a day.

I love this platform when it works, however, the constant updates and glitches that kick me out of the app every time i open it. Please fix this!! It is severely disrupting efficiency. It was good for a while, however, the new update is horrendous

The new login process for the most recent update has been a nightmare. Every time we receive inbox notifications from our patients, we have to re-enter our email and password, which is incredibly frustrating and time-consuming! Occasionally, there’s an option to use a four-digit code, but it doesn’t appear consistently, which makes the experience even more inconsistent.
This change has made the app less user-friendly, especially when we need to respond to patients quickly while on the go. I hope the developers consider reverting to the previous login method or find a more efficient solution, as the current setup is making it difficult to manage communications effectively.

title.label: Disappointed, wish I would have spent more on a more reliable system

content.label: Constant glitches and hard to reach customer service. Updates in the software every few days which often disrupt my clinic in the middle of the day. Most of the updates seem to cause more problems with more updates to try to fix. System freezes and kicks me out frequently. There's no phone number they require you chat for every problem, go through multiple articles, which gets very time consuming and difficult to actually get anything fixed or get ahold of anyone. I signed up because it seemed more affordable that the others but there are a handful of add on fees so I’m not sure that’s the case anymore between paying for other users and reminder texts, etc. I think they have a lot of potential but I’ve been waiting for over 2 years and still waiting. Also very expensive to get your info off this software to switch to another so I feel trapped.
I love it.

They are constantly updating in the middle of the work day. The app is always glitching and erasing notes you saved. The app will also randomly go down and it’s so frustrating being in the middle of seeing patients and not having access to charts or appointments.
